description: 防災ガイドマップ(土砂災害警戒区域(急傾斜地)) [fire, police and emergency services and landslides and debris flows] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 茅野市. 防災ガイドマップの土砂災害警戒区域（急傾斜地）データです。. Coverage: 茅野市. The portal files it under the publisher 茅野市. Its tags are マップ情報, 防災, 防災マップ. It offers 2 resource(s) in csv, geojson. The portal shows 2025-10-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
